$comment: Single source of truth for the HydeCLI native runtime build. Read by bin/build-native.sh and by .github/workflows/build-native.yml. See ARCHITECTURE.md for the rationale behind every entry.

extensions.ctype: Required by illuminate/support and symfony/console for character class checks.
extensions.curl: Required by the self-update command and by Illuminate\Http\Client (Guzzle) for GitHub API access.
extensions.dom: Required by hyde/framework for sitemap and RSS feed generation.
extensions.fileinfo: Required by hyde/framework (Hyde\Facades\Filesystem) and Laravel's file helpers for MIME detection.
extensions.filter: Required by symfony/yaml and Laravel validation helpers.
extensions.iconv: Required by symfony/string and league/commonmark for character set conversion when mbstring cannot be used.
extensions.mbregex: Required by illuminate/support (Str::ucsplit and the string helpers built on mb_split) and by symfony/string.
extensions.mbstring: Required by illuminate/support (Str), league/commonmark, and symfony/string.
extensions.openssl: Required for HTTPS transport in the self-update command and for release signature verification.
extensions.pcntl: Required by symfony/process for signal handling when running `hyde serve` child processes.
extensions.phar: Required to run the embedded application: the executable is a micro SAPI bound to a PHAR.
extensions.posix: Required by symfony/console and laravel/prompts for TTY detection and interactive prompts.
extensions.simplexml: Required by hyde/framework for sitemap and RSS feed generation.
extensions.tokenizer: Required by the Blade compiler in illuminate/view.
extensions.xml: Required as the base extension for dom, simplexml, xmlreader and xmlwriter.
extensions.xmlreader: Required as a dependency of the XML extension family used by feed generation.
extensions.xmlwriter: Required by hyde/framework for sitemap and RSS feed generation.
extensions.zlib: Required to read the GZ-compressed PHAR that the executable embeds.
